issues.label: Scope of remand mandate
issues.why: Court must determine whether Moore II limited remand to discrete issues or permitted comprehensive re-division.

issues.label: Law of the case doctrine
issues.why: Prior appellate rulings bind the trial court and constrain what may be relitigated.

issues.label: Current vs. trial-record income evidence
issues.why: Whether R.C. 3119.04 required consideration of updated income, needs, and lifestyle rather than only 2016-2017 trial evidence.

issues.label: Denial of evidentiary hearing
issues.why: Whether refusing an evidentiary hearing on updated finances was error.

issues.label: Denial of discovery on Robert's income
issues.why: Whether the court improperly refused to compel updated financial discovery.

issues.label: Correct application of R.C. 3119.04
issues.why: Whether the court properly analyzed support for combined incomes exceeding the statutory maximum.

issues.label: R.C. 3119.04(B) findings requirement
issues.why: Whether the court made required findings to award less than the schedule maximum.

issues.label: Reasonableness of $8,500 child support
issues.why: Whether that amount adequately reflects the child's needs, lifestyle, and parties' income disparity.

issues.label: Determination of child's actual needs
issues.why: Whether the court correctly calculated the child-specific monthly expenses from Exhibits BB, XXX, YYY.

issues.label: Nanny expense treatment
issues.why: Whether subtracting one nanny's cost from the child's expenses was proper.

issues.label: Standard-of-living/geographic assumption
issues.why: Whether assuming the child could have lived in Belmont County was supported and appropriate.

issues.label: Effective date of child support order
issues.why: Whether January 1, 2020 conflicts with the decree's non-retroactivity statement per Moore II.

issues.label: Retroactive reduction of support
issues.why: Whether reducing support backward and ordering repayment of overpayments was permissible.

issues.label: Child support overpayment recovery method
issues.why: Whether reducing monthly support by $3,000 to recoup $303,470.81 was proper.

issues.label: Repayment of $153,000 other support
issues.why: Whether ordering repayment of additional support amounts was error.

issues.label: Redesignation of childcare payments as gift
issues.why: Whether the court properly denied recharacterizing childcare payments as gifts.

issues.label: New Albany valuation at termination date
issues.why: Whether the court properly valued the property at the de facto termination date per Moore II instructions.

issues.label: Market loss/gain allocation on New Albany
issues.why: Whether refusing to shift market loss and using sale proceeds instead of appraised value complied with the mandate.

issues.label: Failure to award New Albany to Robert
issues.why: Whether the court erred in not awarding ownership of the home to Robert.

issues.label: Separate vs. marital interest in New Albany
issues.why: Whether the 4.96%/$81,840 separate-interest determination was correct.

issues.label: De facto termination date validity
issues.why: Whether January 30, 2016 (or January 1, 2016) is the proper marital termination date affecting valuations.

issues.label: Jurisdiction to modify property division
issues.why: Whether the court had authority to alter awards beyond the remanded items.

issues.label: Robert's Vero Beach correction
issues.why: Whether the reduction to $863,448 correctly implemented the stipulated $1.7 million marital interest.

issues.label: Debt reallocation corrections
issues.why: Whether jet, tax, and withdrawal debts were correctly reduced to 50 percent as ordered.

issues.label: Comprehensive division under R.C. 3105.171
issues.why: Whether a full re-division of all marital property was required or foreclosed.

issues.label: Equitable division to April
issues.why: Whether the overall property distribution was equitable and adequately justified.

issues.label: Finality under Civ.R. 75(F)
issues.why: Whether the piecemeal entries were properly incorporated into one final judgment.

issues.label: Final appealable order under R.C. 2505.02
issues.why: Whether the ultimate order is now a final appealable order given prior dismissals.

issues.label: Reconsideration of final order
issues.why: Whether the June 12, 2023 entry was a final order not subject to reconsideration.

issues.label: Spousal support waiver
issues.why: Whether the October 2016 waiver was properly enforced in denying spousal support.

issues.label: Imputed vs. estimated income terminology
issues.why: Whether the court's determination of April's income was legally proper despite the terminology issue.

issues.label: Credibility findings on April's income
issues.why: Whether rejecting April's law-firm income evidence was supported by the record.

issues.label: Denial of reimbursement to April
issues.why: Whether refusing to reimburse April for bills paid was proper given the 'double dip' finding.

issues.label: Attorney fee offsets in proceeds
issues.why: Whether subtracting the $30,000 fee award from April's share was correct.

issues.label: Custodial account restraining-order modification
issues.why: Whether allowing the custodian's $1,005,000 withdrawal and dismissal affected a substantial right.

issues.label: Adoption of Robert's proposed order
issues.why: Whether adopting Robert's proposed final order over April's was proper.

issues.label: Standard of review for each ruling
issues.why: Court must apply correct abuse-of-discretion or de novo standards to distinct determinations.
